function.name: calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time taken to cover a distance at a certain speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance to be covered in meters. This is a float type value.

speed.description: The speed at which the object is moving in m/s. This is a float type value.

round_to_nearest_second.description: Optional parameter to round the time to the nearest second.

message.content:
I don’t have direct access to a live clock here, so I’m unable to tell you the precise current time.  
Please check the clock on your computer, phone, or another reliable source (e.g., “What’s the time?” via Siri/Google Assistant). If you let me know what timezone you’re interested in, I can explain how to convert from UTC or GMT to that zone.
message.reasoning:
User asks "What's the time right now?" We need current time. As an AI without real-time clock, we can approximate or say cannot provide exact due to no internet/time sync. But maybe use system's local time if available? In this environment likely not accessible. So respond politely explaining limitation and optionally give UTC based on known offset? Better answer: I don't have access to live clock; you should check your device.

Thus produce response accordingly.
